S05 | DOI 10.1128/aac.00752-06 | Table 1 (DeRyke et al. 2007)

Neutropenic female ICR mice about 25 g (cyclophosphamide 150 mg/kg day -4 and 100 mg/kg day -1 i.p.) made renally impaired with uranyl nitrate 5 mg/kg i.p. 3 days before inoculation.
